text: The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, revolutionized our understanding of space, time, and gravity.
Planck's constant relates the energy of a photon to its frequency.
The Heisenberg uncertainty principle states that one cannot simultaneously know both the position and momentum of a particle with arbitrary precision.
Quantum entanglement allows particles to instantaneously affect each other's states regardless of distance.
The Industrial Revolution marked a major turning point in history, leading to the rise of factories, urbanization, and technological innovation.
The French Revolution was a period of radical social and political upheaval in France.
The Great Fire of London in 1666 destroyed much of the city, leading to significant rebuilding and urban planning changes.
The Renaissance was a period of cultural and artistic rebirth in Europe.
A triathlon tests athletic endurance through sequential legs of swimming, road cycling, and long-distance running.
Offside rules in association football prohibit attacking players from receiving balls behind defensive lines.
The Grand Slam in tennis consists of winning four major annual championships: Australian, French, Wimbledon, and US Open.
Basketball teams use high pick-and-roll maneuvers to force defensive switches and create open perimeter shots.
Composting breaks down organic waste into rich organic humus that improves soil moisture retention and structure.
Photosynthesis enables plants to capture solar photon energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose.
Companion planting pairs beneficial botanical species together to naturally deter pests and maximize crop yields.
Pruning removes diseased or dead stems to stimulate healthy new foliage growth and fruit production.
Phishing attacks use deceptive communication engineered to trick victims into revealing sensitive authentication credentials.
Symmetric encryption utilizes a single shared key for both plaintext encoding and ciphertext decipherment.
Zero-trust network architectures enforce continuous validation of identity credentials across all system access requests.
Ransomware malicious software encrypts critical storage drives and demands financial ransoms for decryption keys.
